summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a partial mandatory redemption of 576,923 Class C preferred shares (PNC), representing 0.0951% of outstanding PNCs, for R$30,000,000, at R$52.00 per share. Holders may elect a 1.1:1 conversion into common shares, though ADS holders are excluded from elective conversion. The redemption, approved by the board on June 13, 2026, occurs on July 7, 2026, on a pro rata basis with fractional entitlements disregarded. Citibank serves as depositary for ADSs, with Banco Bradesco as custodian. This mandatory partial return of capital reduces preferred share overhang; watch for further redemptions or conversion uptake affecting capital structure.
